title: A/B Testing Dashboard
description: Multi-page statistical analysis web app that analyzes experiment data and recommends Launch / Iterate / Kill using p-values, Bayesian Monte Carlo, power analysis, and sample size calculations. Generates consulting-grade PDF reports.

title: AI Trading Engine
description: ML-filtered trading system where XGBoost predicts P(trade net-profitable after costs). Turned a −₹225k simulated loss into +₹93k profit. Walk-forward OOS validated across 3 disjoint bull/bear windows. 6 parallel strategies on Google Cloud.

title: Peptide Hydrogel Prediction
description: ML system predicting hydrogel formation from amino-acid sequences. Built RandomForest models (ROC-AUC 0.888 for amyloid classification, 0.72 for hydrogel), SHAP analysis, and a Flask portal for researcher use.

title: Sales CRM Dashboard
description: Full-stack CRM for managing sales leads with a dashboard featuring KPIs, funnel analysis, and revenue charts. Built with FastAPI backend and Bootstrap 5 + Plotly.js frontend. Supports CSV export and basic auth.

title: Invoice Generator
description: SaaS-ready invoice generation service with PDF export, SQLAlchemy backend, and template-based rendering. Built with FastAPI and deployed with Docker.

title: Resume Builder Pro
description: Gradio web app that generates ATS-friendly LaTeX resumes tailored to specific companies. Features PDF resume analysis, skill gap detection, ATS scoring, and optimization recommendations against company job-role profiles.
